title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Alone or in Combination with Eszopiclone in Comorbid Insomnia and Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Veterans with Posttraumatic Stress Disorder: A Randomized Trial
comparison_or_design: The BBTI comparison involving an initial two-week eszopiclone course.
observations_or_assays: Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index total score
time_scope: Baseline and week 24 only. A requested change must span baseline to week 24; a requested between-arm contrast must explicitly refer to week 24.
excluded: Week-6 outcome summaries; Vector 1/Vector 2 coefficients and their treatment interactions; model intercepts, generic group coefficients and whole-trajectory tests
Questionnaire components/remission categories; CPAP adherence, depression/PTSD, sleep indices and safety
Derived baseline-to-week-24 changes or treatment effects not directly reported in the sources
population_or_material: The main intention-to-treat randomized analysis population of veterans with PTSD and COMISA.
requested_items: Table 3 baseline/week-24 adjusted means and week-24 treatment contrasts; directly reported whole-baseline-to-week-24 PSQI/ISI changes in the abstract. Whole-period ESS change remains missing if unreported. Exclude segmented vectors/interactions, generic group/trajectory tests and registry-only P statements.
case_specific_rules: Use directly reported whole-baseline-to-week-24 changes. Apply the shared denominator rules; do not construct changes by combining segmented model coefficients.
